scope: Read-only audit of the supplied 'Zone C Academic Foundations' spec against live prod SQL (vast-5090) and local code at accuracy/fidelity-remediation HEAD bae02f9
method: psql information_schema / timescaledb_information / pg_class probes (prod DSN), grep symbol traces in HENRI V2 (excl. _archive)

evidence_basis.vector_columns: semantic_index vector(2000) on phylogenetic_engrams_65536 + boundary_axioms; phase_vector vector(2000) on zone_c_engrams/action/ast views

claims.claim: Zone A/B operates at a 50 microsecond vector proposal budget
claims.evidence: henri_dual_speed_harness.py:19 pre-registered kill gate K1 (<= 50 us mean); experiments/performance/phase818_transducer_cuda_check.py:6 measured su3 log kernel <= 50 us
claims.limitation: 50 us is a harness kill-gate target; one component kernel measured; full-proposal-budget latency not measured in this audit
Bandwidth arithmetic, not measured proposal throughput

claims.claim: D=65,536 unit-hypersphere waves S^{D-1} are the Zone C memory substrate
claims.evidence: boundary_axioms dimension=65536 num_blocks=8192 wave_payload=262144 B; phylogenetic_engrams_65536 bytea engram_wave_bytes
claims.limitation: Vector SEARCH columns are 2000-dim JL projections; the 65536-dim wave lives in bytea payloads, not in pgvector columns

claims.evidence: All three names ABSENT from prod pg_class; actual hypertables are zone_c_engrams, zone_c_resonant_hypersphere, external_outcomes
claims.limitation: telemetry_logs exists only as a local gitignored log directory, not a DB hypertable

claims.claim: Chunked B-Tree bounds O(log N_chunk) and sub-millisecond insert at 20 kHz
claims.evidence: create_hypertable present: zone_c_engrams 7-day chunks, zone_c_resonant_hypersphere 1-hour chunks (zone_c_schema.sql:72,95)
claims.limitation: Chunking OBSERVED; the O(log N) and 20 kHz throughput guarantees are unmeasured claims (chunking alone does not establish them)

claims.claim: add_retention_policy: transient fluctuations drop after 7 days
claims.evidence: No drop_chunks/retention policy in prod jobs; only Job History Log Retention, Telemetry Reporter, Refresh CAGG. _archive/v1_runner/zone_c_agentic_database_initialization.py:110 had add_retention_policy(zone_c_engrams, 30 days) - archived, not live, and 30 days not 7

claims.claim: Hierarchical CAGGs cascade 100 Hz -> 1 Hz -> 0.01 Hz with percentile_agg/approx_percentile
claims.evidence: One cagg exists: zone_c_engrams_hourly (1h bucket; AVG/MIN/MAX sagnac_stress, COUNT). No percentile_agg/approx_percentile in code
claims.limitation: Single-tier aggregate only; multi-tier cascade and streaming percentiles not implemented

claims.claim: time_bucket_gapfill fills sensor dropout slots; locf maintains set-point stability
claims.evidence: No time_bucket_gapfill/locf calls in live code; cagg definition contains neither
claims.limitation: Database imputation is not implemented; it would not by itself guarantee Lie-group phase continuity anyway

claims.claim: first()/last() extract boundary conditions for path-integral energy deltas
claims.evidence: No first()/last() calls in live code

claims.claim: pgvector l2/cosine/hamming distance over Z_256^D phase rings and continuous complex hypervectors
claims.evidence: pgvector 0.6.0; cosine retrieval via `1 - (semantic_index <=> q)` on 2000-dim vector(2000) HNSW (zone_c_segment_cache.py:288); no l2_distance/hamming_distance calls in live code
claims.limitation: Search operates on 2000-dim semantic projections, NOT 65536-dim waves; l2/hamming paths absent

claims.claim: add_job('zone_c_attractor_pruner','5 minutes') prunes by EDMD eigenvalues: |lambda|<1-eps dissipate; |lambda|~1 crystallize into axioms
claims.evidence: ZoneCAttractorPruner class exists (zone_c_attractor_pruner.py) but calls consolidate_attractors(cosine_threshold=0.95) - greedy cosine clustering over semantic indices; no eigenvalue/EDMD logic; no add_job in prod jobs; only an in-memory unit test (test_architectural_milestones.py:95)
claims.limitation: Pruner-as-described (EDMD eigenvalue governor) does not exist; cosine consolidation is a different mechanism. Persistent dynamical modes |lambda|~1 are not automatically verified axioms

claims.claim: Sagnac veto: Delta_Sagnac >= 0.35 triggers Langevin heat injection + Zone C rejection
claims.evidence: 0.35 threshold OBSERVED in code: arc_sagnac_veto.py:38 DEFAULT_EPSILON_HARD=0.35, efe_planner.py:902/1595-1611 tau_veto=0.35, henri_agentic_graph_engine.py:160, henri_dual_speed_harness.py:35, henri_universal_repl.py:98, hops_vsa_core.py:34, production_arc_run.py:630. BUT HENRI_ARC_SAGNAC_VETO defaults '0' (production_arc_run.py:200) and CLASS48/49 arms ran at mean sagnac_delta ~0.986-0.988 without veto shutdown
claims.limitation: Calibration conflict: the production telemetry channel sits at ~0.986, far above 0.35, yet arms complete. The 0.35-veto and the telemetry sagnac_delta are either different calibrations/metrics or the veto is not enforced in the ARC path (flag default-OFF). MUST NOT be conflated

claims.evidence: efe_planner.py:9-14: EFE(a) = pragmatic_value(a) - epistemic_value(a); pragmatic_value = Sagnac delta of predicted wave vs boundary axioms; epistemic = entropy/information gain
claims.limitation: Canonical variational FE uses MINUS on the expected log-likelihood: F = D_KL(q||p) - E_q[log p(o|psi)]. The live code expresses pragmatic as a Sagnac error-like term (consistent with pragmatic = -E[log p] if defined as negative log-likelihood), so the displayed formula's PLUS sign is incorrect as written

claims.claim: Elimination of the von Neumann bottleneck via CAGGs + O(log K) vector search
claims.limitation: CAGGs + vector search do not eliminate the von Neumann bottleneck; no latency measurement supports the O(log K)/deterministic-latency claim

claims.evidence: Only an archived comment: _archive/v1_runner/phylogenetic_memory.py:35 'sub-microsecond Sagnac homodyne coherence checks'
claims.limitation: No live mechanism or measurement found

representation_boundary.arc_wave: continuous [num_blocks, 8] S^{D-1} UWE (D=65,536) - consumed by ARC production loop
representation_boundary.zone_c_search: 2000-dim semantic_index JL projection (pgvector vector(2000), HNSW cosine) - the ONLY pgvector-native searchable form
representation_boundary.phase_ring: flat Z_256^65536 uint8 ring - used in coding/REST paths, NOT stored as pgvector vectors
representation_boundary.rule: Do not claim pgvector natively searches 65536-dim qFHRR waves; it searches 2000-dim projections
